### This directory contains [templates](https://help.github.com/en/articles/using-templates-to-encourage-high-quality-issues-and-pull-requests-in-your-repository) for configuring github repository

The files in this directory should be created in a folder named "__.github__" in your repository. The files are kept in this directory for reference

1. [pull request template](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-a-pull-request-template-for-your-repository)
1. [issue request template](https://help.github.com/en/articles/manually-creating-a-single-issue-template-for-your-repository)

#### Also configuration files for
1. [pr-lint](https://github.com/apps/prlint)
1. [pylint](https://www.pylint.org/)
1. [code owners sample](https://help.github.com/en/articles/about-code-owners)
